course_name_original: Trabajo Fin de Grado ( 2ª mención S. Electrónicos)
course_name_en: Final Degree Project (2nd mention Electronic Systems)
prerequisites: The TFG must be defended and evaluated once it has been reliably verified that the student has passed all remaining subjects of the study plan and therefore has all the necessary credits for obtaining the Degree title, except those corresponding to the TFG itself.

learning_outcomes.text: Presentation general: adequacy to standards, legibility, writing, spelling, etc.
Logical and coherent structure in the representation of information, ideas and arguments.
Interest of the author's points of view, judgments and conclusions.
Quality of the presentation: appropriate use of means, correctness of oral expression, logical structuring, adequacy to available time, etc.
Ability to interest and capture the audience's attention.
Synthesize and integrate the competencies acquired in the teachings, specifically the general competencies of the degree (CG1 to CG9) and various specific competencies depending on the topic.

syllabus_topics: The contents of the Final Degree Project will be framed within one of the work topics included in the area of Engineering in which the student has completed their studies, as indicated in the objectives of each degree.

assessment_methods.method: Monitoring of the student's face-to-face activities by their academic tutor
Final document presented by the student
Public presentation of the work before the tribunal and subsequent debate with it

assessment_rules: The evaluation, both ordinary and extraordinary, is carried out through a public presentation before a tribunal of three professors from the School. Although the Final Degree Project may be part of a joint work, the presentation must be individual, clearly stating the particular aspects or contribution of each student to the whole. The final definition of the evaluation system will comply with the regulations defined in the Final Degree Regulation of the Polytechnic School of Engineering.
bibliography: Regulation of TFG of the Polytechnic School of Engineering, which will complement the Generic Regulation of TFG of the University of Oviedo (BOPA of July 17, 2012).
Regulation on the Final Degree Project subject at the University of Oviedo (BOPA of March 30, 2020).

The Generic Regulation, as well as the specific one of the Polytechnic School of Engineering, and other related documents (such as the Act and the Evaluation Matrix, among others) are updated on the Web: https://epigijon.uniovi.es/estudiantes/tfg
